meta.title: Wayback Link Fixer — multisite SEPARATE mode QA
meta.description: Multisite (main + garren + dexter) in separate-tables mode: each site has its own links table with overlapping URLs, ready for separate-to-shared merge QA.
meta.author: gin0115

steps.command: wp network meta update 1 iawmlf_post_activation_onboarding iawmlf_onboarding_completed
wp network meta update 1 iawmlf_multisite_links_table_mode separate

steps.data:
blog_id; \Internet_Archive\Wayback_Machine_Link_Fixer\Migration\Migrations::multisite_up( $id ); $t = $wpdb->get_blog_prefix( $id ) . 'iawmlf_link_archive'; for ( $i = 1; $i <= 20; $i++ ) { $broken = ( 0 === $i % 4 ) ? 1 : 0; $wpdb->insert( $t, array( 'url' => 'https://example.com/site' . $id . '-link-' . $i, 'is_broken' => $broken, 'archived' => null, 'checks' => $broken ? '[{"date":"2026-0' . ( ( $id % 9 ) + 1 ) . '-01 00:00:00","http_code":404}]' : '[]', 'message' => '', 'redirect_url' => '', 'excluded' => 0, 'archive_process' => 'new', ) ); } for ( $i = 1; $i <= 5; $i++ ) { $wpdb->insert( $t, array( 'url' => 'https://example.com/common-link-' . $i, 'is_broken' => ( 1 === $id % 2 ) ? 1 : 0, 'archived' => null, 'checks' => '[{"date":"2026-0' . ( ( $id % 9 ) + 1 ) . '-15 00:00:00","http_code":200}]', 'message' => '', 'redirect_url' => '', 'excluded' => 0, 'archive_process' => 'new', ) ); } switch_to_blog( $id ); wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'QA Post (site ' . $id . ')', 'post_content' => '

Own link

', 'post_status' => 'publish' ) ); restore_current_blog(); echo 'site ' . $id . ' table ' . $t . ' rows ' . (int) $wpdb->get_var( "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `$t`" ) . "\n"; }
